page_title: STR 1-1 LEN | Strasbourg v Lens 27/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Clement Turpin is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' Amadou Haidara (Lens) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Mike Penders was ready and made a save.
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Diego Moreira is given a rest as he is replaced by Maximillian Oyedele (Strasbourg).
90+1' Allan Saint-Maximin (Lens) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
89' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
87' Matthieu Udol (Lens) is given a fully deserved yellow card.

84' The ball falls kindly for Matthieu Udol (Lens) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.

83' A sweet pass finds Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Robin Risser is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
81' Substitution. Florian Sotoca (Lens) on for Florian Thauvin.
79' This is a yellow card! Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
79' Shots on target – 4:4.
76' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Martial Godo is replaced by Lucas Hogsberg (Strasbourg).
73' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Amadou Haidara (Lens) replaces Adrien Thomasson.
72' Substitution. Wesley Said leaves the pitch and is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Lens).

72' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
68' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) serves up a nice cross, but Robin Risser punches the ball away.
67' Referee Clement Turpin reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
66' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Strasbourg, he's going to review using VAR.
65' Malang Sarr (Lens) tackles a bit over-zealously and Clement Turpin blows for a foul. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Strasbourg.

62' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds a long way out to the feet of Mamadou Sangare (Lens), who immediately sends it back towards goal. He hits it extremely well. Mike Penders is helpless against the projectile, which deflects in off the bottom of the left post. The score changes to 1:1.
62' Lens will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
62' Florian Thauvin (Lens) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Good work from Lens as they win a corner.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Allan Saint-Maximin (Lens) comes onto the pitch for Odsonne Edouard.
60' Lens force a corner. They send men into the box.

60' Great solo effort by Florian Thauvin (Lens) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save. Now Lens have a corner.

59' Florian Thauvin (Lens) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Florian Thauvin (Lens) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
58' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Mike Penders easily deals with the threat.
58' Matthieu Udol (Lens) latches on to an accurate cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends the ball towards goal, but it's too easy for the keeper.
56' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Penders intercepts the ball.
52' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
49' Matthieu Udol (Lens) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
49' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) steps up to send the ball in.
48' Wesley Said (Lens) works the corner short.
47' Malang Sarr (Lens) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Odsonne Edouard (Lens), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
44' The move breaks down when Odsonne Edouard (Lens) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post.
42' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
42' Lens earn a corner.
41' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' Matthieu Udol (Lens) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
39' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.

37' Florian Thauvin (Lens) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
36' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Lens.

34' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.

33' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives to stop the effort.
31' The linesman points to the corner flag, Strasbourg are going to take it.
31' An accurate cross picks out Wesley Said (Lens) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
30' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes a direct free kick.

27' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
26' Nidal Celik (Lens) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Strasbourg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
24' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
23' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 1:0.
15' A pass from Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) is intercepted by Robin Risser and the move breaks down.
12' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) will take the corner.

11' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Robin Risser makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner. The referee points to the corner flag and Strasbourg will take a corner.
8' Strasbourg are seeing far more of the ball now.
5' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
5' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
4' That's a clear yellow card. Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) goes into the book.
4' The foul by Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) was seen by Clement Turpin who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lens was in an offside position.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lens will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Clement Turpin.
